_format: One entry per clinic in clinics. town and type are text (for example "Oakbrook Terrace" and "Recovery clinic"). signups60 and bookedFirstVisits60 are whole numbers: tracked sign-ups and booked first visits in the clinic's first 60 days. referenceCalls is true when the owner takes reference calls.
